1283-1651-2557-7824-8276.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Hive by paying {5} and tapping it, creating four 1/1 Wasp artifact creature tokens due to Parallel Lives and Bard.
Activate Clock of Omens twice by tapping the Wasps, untapping Chromatic Orrery and The Hive.
Repeat.
1283-1651-2557-7824-8276.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

643-2921-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
643-2921-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Repeat from step 3.

413-1339-4616.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
413-1339-4616.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

728-1531-1981-2415.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1303-1769-8095.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Rot Hulk enters, it and Necroduality trigger.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Rot Hulk.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, failing to return anything to the battlefield.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of Rot Hulk.
When the token Rot Hulk enters, it triggers, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1445-2267-4247-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2267-4247-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3129-4365-6753-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

5078-6089-7010.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
5078-6089-7010.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Gran-Gran.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Skyswimmer Koi triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Skyswimmer Koi trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-6972-7511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Witch-king
When Witch-king dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Witch-king
When Witch-king dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2511-6972-7511.notes: If Witch-king starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

1722-1912-2034-6753-7365.description:
Activate Katara by paying at most {4} due to Biomancer's Familiar, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create two creature tokens.
Activate Katara by paying at most {2} and tapping the creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Katara ability, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
1722-1912-2034-6753-7365.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you tap combo pieces or other applicable permanents while activating Katara's waterbend ability the first iteration. As the combo will net {C} each iteration, you can forego sacrificing and/or tapping both tokens on some loops.

1069-2457-5499-7297.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-2457-5499-7297.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Insect.
Activate the Insect by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat step 1 as desired.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1169-5921-5970-7014.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of North Pole Patrol.
Activate one of the North Pole Patrol tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other North Pole Patrol token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1308-1409-1780.description:
Activate Burdened Aerialist by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Burdened Aerialist enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Burdened Aerialist.
Resolve the Burdened Aerialist trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-6972-7158.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Arcbound Slasher.
When Arcbound Slasher dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Slasher's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Slasher from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1017-3532-5060-5078.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
1017-3532-5060-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1495-4772-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Triskelion triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Doubling Season.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
1495-4772-6919.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

2457-2557-3000-5794.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the Squirrel and Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

586-2438-3168-5258-5618.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2816-3918-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
2816-3918-5527.notes: You must control four or more Clues to net mana.

2468-2751-4821.notablePrerequisites: Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
2468-2751-4821.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Dramatic Reversal without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Dramatic Reversal, untapping all nonland permanents you xontrol.
Repeat from step 2.

1988-4186-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Blade of the Bloodchief attached to Scurry Oak.
You control at least one additional creature.
1988-4186-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Blade of the Bloodchief triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

773-1409-3809.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Galazeth Prismari.
773-1409-3809.description:
Activate Galazeth Prismari by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Galazeth Prismari enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Galazeth Prismari.
Resolve the Galazeth Prismari, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

1789-2232-2459-4875.notablePrerequisites:
"Dragon" chosen with Conspiracy.
You have enough mana to pay for commnader tax, if applicable.
1789-2232-2459-4875.description:
Cast Rograkh either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {0} plus commnander tax, if applicable.
When Rograkh enters the battlefield, Lathliss and Cloudstone Curio triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Rograkh from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

859-940.notablePrerequisites:
Arcane Teachings attached to Lurking Roper.
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to give Lurking Roper lifelink.
859-940.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain one life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

45-1987-3075-3277.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
45-1987-3075-3277.description:
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Khalni Gem and Izzet Chronarch, blinking them.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Khalni Gem enters the battlefield, return two lands you control to your hand if able.
Repeat.
